pricing.faq.title: FAQ
pricing.faq.a1: We only collect public data: HN, Reddit, V2EX, ProductHunt, GitHub, Google Trends, Lobsters, IndieHackers, Weibo via open APIs and public pages. Quotes are ≤30 chars and always link back. Authors can email takedown@example.com to request removal.
pricing.faq.q2: What's the difference between Pro Weekly and Studio Brief?
pricing.faq.a2: Weekly is broad (Top-20) but shallow — great for situational awareness. Studio digs into one high-score pain point with 13 sections (user, scenario, competitors, MVP, monetization) — for when you're ready to build.
pricing.faq.a3: 7-day no-questions-asked refund on subscriptions. Briefs are non-refundable once delivered, but you can swap to another brief at the same price tier.
pricing.faq.a4: We're tuning data coverage and scoring during beta. Waitlist members get rolled in over the next 2-3 weeks.

press.boilerplate.title: About DemandRadar
press.boilerplate.body: DemandRadar is an automated demand radar for indie hackers, solo founders, and micro-SaaS builders. It continuously scans 9+ public sources — including Hacker News, Reddit, GitHub, Product Hunt and Indie Hackers — and ships a weekly Top-20 of high-willingness-to-pay pain points plus 13-section project briefs ready to build over a weekend.
